title: CI: add checkov + tflint jobs, tune false positives, document suppression policy
author: Sahana Iyer
release_notes: Adds CI security/static analysis gates (checkov + tflint) with a documented skip/suppression policy and tuned rules to reduce false positives for alpha modules.
description:
Context: As part of the Private VPC Terraform modules alpha, we need consistent CI gates that catch common IaC security issues early (and reduce support burden from inconsistent module patterns). This PR introduces checkov and tflint in GitHub Actions, tunes the ruleset to avoid known false positives on module patterns, and documents how/when we allow suppressions.

What’s in this PR: (1) New GitHub Actions jobs: tflint (with AWS ruleset) and checkov. Both run on PRs and on main. Both are configured to annotate PRs with actionable failures. (2) Repository config: .tflint.hcl with a pinned tflint version + aws ruleset version; checkov config to fail only on HIGH/CRITICAL by default for alpha, plus a small allowlist of checks we intentionally defer with explicit justification. (3) Suppression policy doc: adds docs/security/checkov-suppressions.md describing required format for any skip (reason + owner + link to issue + review requirements), and “no blanket suppressions” guidance.

Why this approach: We want security-by-default, but we also want predictable CI. A number of checks are not module-aware (especially where a wrapper module composes secure defaults), and would otherwise force noisy suppressions on every PR. The policy is intended to (a) make skips explicit and reviewable by Security, and (b) make it easy to remove skips as we move from alpha to beta.

Notable tuning / false positives addressed: - checkov VPC Flow Logs check flagged vpc-baseline even when flow logs are enabled via the separate flow-logs module in wrapper compositions; documented as a known limitation and handled via targeted skip on the baseline module with a pointer to the wrapper that enforces flow logs. - interface endpoint “policy not set” warnings on endpoints that intentionally rely on org SCPs/central policies; we keep the warning surfaced in docs and track a follow-up to add opinionated endpoint policies in a later PR. - tflint noise from examples (unused declarations / provider constraints) is limited by scoping and rule configuration; examples still run fmt/validate.

Acceptance criteria: - CI runs terraform fmt/validate + terraform-docs (existing) and now also runs tflint and checkov. - Failing findings block merge. - Any suppression requires a justification and a link (Linear/Jira). - Rules/versions are pinned to avoid surprise drift.

Follow-ups: (1) ENG-4874 (new): add opinionated endpoint policies for ECR/S3/Logs and remove related checkov skips where possible. (2) Once alpha stabilizes, we should revisit severity thresholds (move MEDIUM into gating for beta) and/or enable SARIF upload for Security dashboards.
commits: ci: add tflint + checkov GitHub Actions workflows
tflint: pin versions and add .tflint.hcl w/ aws plugin
checkov: add config + initial targeted skips for known module limitations
docs: add suppression policy + review requirements
ci: tighten gates, improve output, and add PR annotations
changed_files: modules/vpc-baseline/main.tf (targeted checkov skip comments w/ justification)
README.md (CI badges + short note on security checks)
review_conversation:
Marcus Lin (Security) - Requested changes: Please do not land checkov skips without a documented policy. For each skip, require a reason + owner + tracking link. Also, please confirm we’re not suppressing anything that would allow public ingress/egress by default.

Sahana Iyer (Author) - Reply: Added docs/security/checkov-suppressions.md with required fields and review expectations. Updated all skip comments to include (a) why it’s a false positive or module limitation, (b) owner (Infra/Sec), and (c) tracking link. We’re not skipping any SG/NACL/public access checks; all skips are limited to non-module-aware checks that are enforced by wrapper composition.

Irene Choi (Infra) - Comment: tflint is currently failing on a couple of example configs for unused variables and provider constraints. Can we scope the stricter rules to modules/ and keep examples linted but less strict?

Sahana Iyer (Author) - Reply: Updated tflint job to run in modules/** with strict rules and run a lighter pass (no aws ruleset) for examples to catch syntax issues without drowning in noise. Also pinned plugin versions.

Kevin Osei (Security) - Comment: Checkov severity threshold set to HIGH/CRITICAL is OK for alpha, but we need a path to tighten later. Can you add that note explicitly and link to a follow-up ticket?

Sahana Iyer (Author) - Reply: Added follow-up notes in PR description and created ENG-4875 to revisit severity thresholds for beta.

Victor Alvarez (Networking) - Comment: Please ensure the pipeline output is readable for PS/solutions folks (actionable errors, not 10k lines). The current checkov output is a bit verbose.

Sahana Iyer (Author) - Reply: Switched to compact output + summary, and kept the full JSON artifact upload for debugging. Also added a short section in README on where to find CI artifacts.

Final approvals: Marcus Lin approved after policy doc + targeted skips; Irene Choi approved after tflint scoping; Kevin Osei approved with follow-up ticket; Victor Alvarez approved.
merge_outcome: Merged into main after CI green and Security/Infra approvals.
